description: This line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (Eval PPL) on the y-axis against the ratio of estimated parameters on the x-axis, for four different model architectures as indicated by the legend. The x-axis, labeled “Estimated Parameters Ratio (%)”, ranges from 100 to 250 with tick marks at intervals of 25, indicating a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “Eval PPL”, ranges from approximately 11.5 to 14.0, also on a linear scale. The plot contains four distinct lines: the “Transformer” is shown as a dashed orange line with triangle markers; “Only MoHD FFN” is a solid gray line with square markers; “Only MoHD ATTN” is a solid dark blue line with circle markers; and “MoHD ATTN + MLP” is a solid blue line with cross markers. The “Transformer” line remains relatively flat, starting near 12.0 and ending near 12.3. The “Only MoHD FFN” line starts near 11.5 and steadily increases to approximately 13.1. The “Only MoHD ATTN” line starts near 11.5, rises to about 13.0 at a ratio of 50%, and then sharply increases to nearly 14.0 at a ratio of 25%. The “MoHD ATTN + MLP” line begins near 11.5, rises to about 13.0 at a ratio of 50%, and then continues to increase steeply to nearly 14.0 at a ratio of 25%.
